coordinate_frame: Query RGB camera at anchor 20; +X image right, +Y image down, +Z forward; metres.
transform_convention: Row-major 4x4 matrices acting on column vectors; root_T_anchor maps Wuji hand local coordinates into query-anchor camera coordinates. Translation is source wrist (left index 5, right index 33).

provenance.retargeting_method: Same WujiRetargeter, ARIA-to-MediaPipe conversion, root estimation and operator-to-MANO convention as retarget_final.py; optimizer and filter reset before every hand pose; apply_filter=False.
provenance.interpretation: Before is the last DDIM proposal in the steered run, already affected by seven earlier blends. After is its actual final 0.5 blend toward the aligned human guide. Unsteered is the independent unsteered run with the same initial noise; compare unsteered to after for whole-run influence. These are retargeted visualization poses, not robot execution.
